systemConfig.pageDescription: Centrally manage operating hours, holidays, emergency maintenance modes, and security policies.

operations.hoursDescription: Configure operating days and business hours for customer service.
operations.lunchDescription: Displays an away notice on the 1:1 inquiry widget during lunch breaks.
operations.holidayDescription: Specified dates are automatically treated as non-working days for customer support.

maintenance.title: System Maintenance
maintenance.description: When enabled, user access is restricted and a maintenance notice is shown. If a schedule is set, it will activate automatically during that window.
maintenance.messagePlaceholder: e.g., System maintenance is currently in progress. Please check back shortly.

security.authDescription: Configure registration permissions, login failure account lockout, and password expiration policies.
security.inquiryDescription: Configure thresholds for unanswered inquiry alerts and automatic resolution/closure.
security.slackDescription: Configure Incoming Webhook URL to receive urgent system alerts.

messages.title: Contextual Customer Notice Messages
messages.description: Notice messages displayed on user dashboards and 1:1 chat widgets based on operational state.
